## How Strict works

Strict wraps GitHub's official runner instead of proxying your builds. Source code and secrets travel directly between your machine and GitHub; Strict runs beside it over Tailscale to balance load and heal disks.

- 01 Pair over Tailscale Run the Mac app or standalone server behind tailscale serve . Enroll spare Macs and Linux hosts with a pairing code or SSHâno open ports or required login. â

- 02 Native GitHub runner Each machine runs GitHub's official actions/runner as a zero-sudo user service ( launchd or systemd --user ). Workflows pull straight from GitHub over outbound HTTPS. â

- 03 Auto load-balancing Lightweight host agents report CPU, memory, and free NVMe every few seconds. Hot or tight hosts drain idle slots onto healthy peers and recover automatically. â

- 04 Warm NVMe & self-healing DerivedData, SwiftPM, Cargo, and Docker layers stay warm on disk or share over your tailnet cache. 7-tier cleanup prunes stale builds while skipping live jobs. â
